marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 遇见未知的自己 : 都市个人成长修行课 | Yu jian wei zhi de zi ji : du shi ge ren cheng zhang xiu xing ke

While our material lives are becoming increasingly abundant, more and more people are struggling with depression and anxiety. That’s because we’ve gone off course—constantly competing, comparing, and grasping in the external world, while few take the time to focus on inner fulfillment and true joy. I hope that the classic book “Meeting the Unknown Self” will continue to awaken more people, reminding them that the real path to happiness and well-being lies within—in self-exploration, in pleasing oneself rather than trying to please others. Those who are willing to listen, reflect, and realign themselves in time will find themselves growing steadily in happiness and peace. But for those who remain fixated on chasing external rewards and achievements, life’s suffering will only become more intense and overwhelming. When we are willing to surrender and humbly release our pain, embracing the flow of life as it is, there is a sense of freedom and liberation that I hope more people will come to experience
